name: Meenakshi Amman Temple
description: Historic Dravidian temple complex dedicated to Goddess Meenakshi and Sundareswarar, famous for its 14 towering gopurams adorned with detailed mythological sculptures.

name: Thirumalai Nayakkar Mahal
description: 17th-century palace built by King Tirumala Nayaka, renowned for its Indo-Saracenic architectural style, colossal white stucco pillars, and evening light and sound show.

name: Gandhi Memorial Museum
description: Historic palace-turned-museum housing Mahatma Gandhi's personal artifacts, freedom struggle exhibitions, and tranquil surrounding gardens.

name: Alagar Kovil & Pazhamudircholai
description: Scenic hill temple dedicated to Lord Vishnu and Murugan set amid lush forested Western Ghat foothills, featuring natural springs and peaceful panoramic viewpoints.

name: Madurai Famous Jigarthanda & Heritage Food Walk
description: Culinary trail in the heritage bazaars around East Masi Street sampling authentic Madurai Jigarthanda, Bun Parotta, and Kari Dosa.

name: Vandiyur Mariamman Teppakulam
description: Enormous temple tank with an island pavilion (Maiya Mandapam) in the center, a scenic and breezy gathering spot during twilight.
